page.layout: One title page, centred. Printer's ornament at the top, title lines in the centre, a woodcut device in the middle, imprint lines below it. The scan is printed upside down.
page.notes: The whole page is printed upside down on the scan. I have read the lines in their printed order. The top line is a printer's ornament and is not transcribed. Below the text is a woodcut device (a shield-like emblem with a diagonal band, in a rectangular frame), which I have not transcribed. The date is printed as "clɔ IƆ LXXVI", read as MDLXXVI. The line "AVTHORE CALLERIO" and the place name "LAVSANNÆ" are uncertain because of the inverted, faint print. The line after "IN VSVM SCHO-" is too faint to read reliably. The second line of the title is in a decorative italic capital "Q", read here as QVÆ.
